title: City of Mobile Animal Services hopes the holidays bring more forever families - NewsBreak
text:
By Kathryn Bruch ,
1 hours ago
MOBILE, Ala. ( WKRG ) — The City of Mobile Animal Services is hoping the holiday season brings new beginnings for the more than 100 animals that are currently waiting in the city shelter.
Goo Goo Dolls to perform at The Wharf Director Robert Bryant said the holidays are one of the most important times of year to get pets into safe and loving homes, even if it’s just temporarily.
“During the holidays, you know, we really make a big push to get animals into not just foster homes, but we’d love to get them adopted as well,” Bryant said. “I mean, what’s better than a complete family for the holidays?”
Bryant says that every time a dog leaves the shelter, whether it’s a short-term foster or a full adoption, it frees up space for another stray needing a warm place to stay during colder months.
“The true reality is we’re always full or at capacity,” he said. “So, the more dogs we can get out on a daily basis, opens up more room for us to take care of other dogs that are in need.”
“We push adoptions heavily during this time of the year because we’d really like to get as many dogs off the road that are out in the cold weather,” he continued.
Even families looking to gift a pet this Christmas are encouraged to take an extra moment to talk it through beforehand.
“You don’t want to dump a dog on somebody who’s not ready for that responsibility,” Bryant said. “But at the same time, if there is open communication and they’re ready for a dog, we’ll help work that out for you.”
And for those still unsure about adopting or fostering, Bryant hopes the spirit of the season might make the decision a little easier.
“What’s the better time to do that than Christmas time? You know, you bring home an animal, complete your family,” he said.
“And, I mean, just have fun. Dogs make things better.”
City of Mobile Animal Services is rolling out several holiday efforts to help get pets into homes this season.
The shelter’s Holiday Adoption-thon runs through the month of December, waiving adoption fees for anyone who submits an application before the new year.
They’re also offering a Holiday Foster Program now through Jan. 2, giving people a chance to take a pet home short-term if they’re not ready for a full adoption.
